question: Did Lord Elgin have permission to take the Parthenon marbles?
gold_answer: Disputed. Elgin said the removal was authorised by an Ottoman firman of July 1801 and approved by Athens' local officials, and an 1816 parliamentary Select Committee cleared him. Wikipedia says the legality of Elgin's actions has been disputed.

question: Did Shakespeare and Cervantes die on the same day?
gold_answer: No. Both deaths are dated 23 April 1616, but Spain used the Gregorian calendar and England the Julian, so they were not the same day (Shakespeare's 23 April was 3 May in Gregorian terms). Also, Cervantes actually died on 22 April 1616; 23 April is now understood to be his burial date.
